crossRefs.note: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
“Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.
“This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

translations.web: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
translations.bsb: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
translations.kjv: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
translations.asv: I cry unto Jehovah with my voice, And he answereth me out of his holy hill. Selah
